# data-sa-006 Investment portfolio covariance matrix analysis across market epochs.

## Task Instructions
In this task, you will use the Quantitative Risk Management dataset to calculate and save covariance matrices for three distinct time periods: "before," "during," and "after." Based on the `epochs_description.txt` file, perform the calculations and ensure that the results are saved according to the required submission format for each corresponding time period. Confirm that the matrices are calculated accurately and saved in the correct format.
